captions.en: Streets used to be measured by the cars they carried…
A pavement with room for you, and shade along the way.

captions.ar: وفي قلبِ المدينة… صار الطريقُ ساحةً للِقاء.
captions.en: In the heart of the city, the road became a place to meet.
Green spaces breathing between the stone.

captions.ar: وحين يهدأ النهار… تبقى المدينةُ مُضاءةً لأهلها وزوّارها.
captions.en: When the day settles, the city stays lit for its people and its guests.

captions.ar: جودةُ الحياة… أن تمشيَ في مدينتك على مَهَل.
captions.en: Quality of life is walking your city, at ease.
